survey.label: Jun 2026
survey.device: LCMS 3D laser, MPD per 10 m segment in 5 transverse bands

unit_numbering: Web numbering: unit 1 at threshold 07L, unit 360 at threshold 25R.

axis.x_rule: x = distance along the sample-unit centreline from the outer edge of unit 1 (threshold 07L).
axis.station_rule: station = distance from the outer edge of unit 360 (threshold 25R) = 3600.82 − x; falls as the unit number rises (skid convention).

keel.rule: A band value is in the keel when it is valid and |offset| ≤ 6 m at full MATLAB precision (keel column of the package; not recomputed from the rounded offset).

k_rule.note: k_flags compare the keel ETD of the unit with these levels. Stored for the K axis of the SKG scheme; not used in the risk calculation yet.

lanes.rule: Valid values with unit > 0. Lane i = floor((offset_m + 30) / 0.5), limited to 0..119, covers [−30 + 0.5i, −30 + 0.5(i+1)) m; offset 30.00 falls in lane 119. Uses the offset rounded to 0.01 m, so lanes −6..+6 m can differ from the keel statistics by a few values.

caveats: Grooving is unknown. AC 150/5320-12C par. 3-24 does not allow groove depth to be measured. If the runway is grooved and the LCMS did not remove the grooves, MPD reads too high.
The LCMS MPD algorithm (E1845 or ISO 13473-1), the sample interval and the calibration are not yet confirmed. The order of the band polygons is assumed to match MPDBand1–MPDBand5.
